fieldDescription:
How much the Objects Analysis tooltip tells you.
Precise: derelict ships by name and class, fleets by name.
Normal: objects by the names the game shows, fleets counted as hostile, neutral and friendly.
Vague: only whether something is left to salvage, and how many fleets there are.
List the fleets in the current star system too. In hyperspace, only fleets within one map grid cell.
